#### Local function to plot maps | smoothed contour lines -----
```{r}
## smoothed contour version due to high res of newer bio oracle ras's  ----
plot_clim_map <- function(ras,
                          cbar_title = cbar_title,
                          contour_smooth = TRUE,
                          contour_sigma = 2,
                          contour_colour = "white") {

   ## Ensure input is a RasterLayer ----
  if (raster::nlayers(ras) != 1) {
    stop("Raster must contain exactly one layer")
  }
  
  if (!inherits(ras, "RasterLayer")) {
    ras <- ras[[1]]
  }
  
  ## Smooth raster for contour lines only ----
  if (contour_smooth) {

    # Gaussian smoothing kernel
    k <- raster::focalWeight(
      ras,
      d = contour_sigma * raster::res(ras)[1],
      type = "Gauss"
    )

    # Normalize kernel weights
    k <- k / sum(k)

    # Identify valid raster cells
    ras_valid <- !is.na(ras)

    # Replace NA values with zero for weighted smoothing
    ras_filled <- ras
    ras_filled[is.na(ras_filled)] <- 0

    # Weighted sum of raster values
    ras_weighted <- raster::focal(
      ras_filled,
      w = k,
      fun = sum,
      pad = TRUE,
      padValue = 0
    )

    # Sum of weights for valid cells
    ras_weights <- raster::focal(
      ras_valid * 1,
      w = k,
      fun = sum,
      pad = TRUE,
      padValue = 0
    )

    # Normalize to account for missing cells
    ras_contour <- ras_weighted / ras_weights

    # Preserve original NA mask
    ras_contour <- raster::mask(
      ras_contour,
      ras
    )

  } else {

    ras_contour <- ras

  }


  ## Plot raster ----
  g <- plot_var(
    data = ras |> ras2pts(),
    mapdata,
    bbox,
    cpal = rev(cpal),
    .legend = TRUE,
    .interp = TRUE
  )


  ## Add contour lines ----
  gg <- g +
    add_border() +
    resize_cbar(29) +

    # add_major_contour_lines(
    #   df = ras_contour |> ras2pts() |>
    #     mutate(val = value, lon = x, lat = y),
    #   contours = .contours_major,
    #   linewidth = 0.75
    # ) +
    
    ggplot2::geom_contour(
      data = ras_contour |> ras2pts() |>
        mutate(val = value, lon = x, lat = y),
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = val),
      breaks = .contours_major,
      colour = contour_colour,
      linewidth = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    add_basemap()


  ## Format colour bar ----
  gg_formatted <- gg %>%
    addColorBar(
      .,
      c("white", rev(cpal[1:93])),
      limits = limits,
      breaks = breaks,
      cbar_labels = breaks,
      plot_type = "continuous"
    ) +

    rename_legend(title = cbar_title)


  return(gg_formatted)

}
```

#### Local function to plot diff maps | smooth contour-----
```{r}
## Plot climate difference maps with smoothed contours ----
plot_clim_diff_map <- function(ras,
                               cbar_title = cbar_title,
                               contour_smooth = TRUE,
                               contour_sigma = 2,
                               contour_colour = "white") {

  ## Ensure input is a RasterLayer ----
  if (raster::nlayers(ras) != 1) {
    stop("Raster must contain exactly one layer")
  }

  if (!inherits(ras, "RasterLayer")) {
    ras <- ras[[1]]
  }


  ## Smooth raster for contour lines only ----
  if (contour_smooth) {

    # Gaussian smoothing kernel
    k <- raster::focalWeight(
      ras,
      d = contour_sigma * raster::res(ras)[1],
      type = "Gauss"
    )

    # Normalize kernel weights
    k <- k / sum(k)

    # Identify valid raster cells
    ras_valid <- !is.na(ras)

    # Replace NA values with zero for weighted smoothing
    ras_filled <- ras
    ras_filled[is.na(ras_filled)] <- 0

    # Weighted sum of raster values
    ras_weighted <- raster::focal(
      ras_filled,
      w = k,
      fun = sum,
      pad = TRUE,
      padValue = 0
    )

    # Sum of weights for valid cells
    ras_weights <- raster::focal(
      ras_valid * 1,
      w = k,
      fun = sum,
      pad = TRUE,
      padValue = 0
    )

    # Normalize to account for missing cells
    ras_contour <- ras_weighted / ras_weights

    # Preserve original NA mask
    ras_contour <- raster::mask(
      ras_contour,
      ras
    )

  } else {

    ras_contour <- ras

  }


  ## Plot raster ----
  g <- plot_var(
    data = ras |> ras2pts(),
    mapdata,
    bbox,
    cpal = div_pal,
    .interp = TRUE,
    .legend = TRUE
  )


  ## Add contour lines ----
  gg <- g +
    add_border() +
    resize_cbar(29) +

    # add_major_contour_lines(
    #   df = ras_contour |> ras2pts() |>
    #     mutate(val = value, lon = x, lat = y),
    #   contours = .contours_major,
    #   linewidth = 0.75
    # ) +
    ggplot2::geom_contour(
      data = ras_contour |> ras2pts() |>
        mutate(val = value, lon = x, lat = y),
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = val),
      breaks = .contours_major,
      colour = contour_colour,
      linewidth = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +

    add_basemap()


  ## Format colour bar ----
  gg_formatted <- gg %>%
    addColorBar(
      .,
      div_pal[1:18],
      limits = limits,
      breaks = breaks,
      cbar_labels = cbar_labels,
      plot_type = "continuous"
    ) +

    rename_legend(title = cbar_title)


  return(gg_formatted)

}
```

## Crop Figs ----
### Sort Files in Chron Order
```{r}
# create movie
library(gtools)


# List plots files
# flist <- list.files(here('figs'),pattern = "clim_map",full.names=T)
flist <- list.files(here('figs'),pattern = "expanded_lons",full.names=T)
plot_files <- flist#[grepl(glue("_{env_info$eov}"), flist, fixed=TRUE)] 

plot_files_extent <- plot_files#[grepl(p_extent, plot_files, fixed=TRUE)] 

pfiles <- plot_files_extent[order(basename(plot_files_extent))]

pfiles <- gtools::mixedsort(pfiles)

```
